metas.name: The Critic
metas.description: Out 28 Oct 2024 — Jimmy Erskine is the most feared theatre critic of the age. He lives as flamboyantly as he writes and takes pleasure in savagely taking down any actor who fails to meet his standards. When the owner of the Daily Chronicle dies, and his son takes over, Jimmy quickly finds himself at odds with his new boss and his position under threat. In an attempt to preserve the power and influence he holds so sacred, Jimmy strikes a Faustian pact with a struggling actress, entangling them and the boss in a thrilling but deadly web of desire, blackmail, and betrayal.

metas.name: All You Need Is Blood
metas.description: Out 27 Oct 2024 — Bucky is a 16-year-old aspiring director who dreams of becoming the next arthouse auteur sensation. After a strange meteor crash lands in his backyard and turns his deadbeat father into a brain-eating zombie, Bucky and his friends seize the opportunity to create the ultimate horror flick, starring his undead dad.

trailerStreams.title: All You Need Is Blood — trailer

metas.name: The Count of Monte Cristo
metas.description: Out 26 Oct 2024 — Edmond Dantès becomes the target of a sinister plot and is arrested on his wedding day for a crime he did not commit. After 14 years in the island prison of Château d’If, he manages a daring escape. Now rich beyond his dreams, he assumes the identity of the Count of Monte-Cristo and exacts his revenge on the three men who betrayed him.

trailerStreams.title: The Count of Monte Cristo — trailer

metas.name: 1 Million Followers
metas.description: Out 25 Oct 2024 — Karissa, a small-town girl, is invited by a renowned influencer to a mansion in Thailand where the beautiful mingle as they build Karissa up to a million followers. Things take a dark turn with the introduction of the guests' mysterious sponsor and true intentions are revealed.

metas.name: Long Distance
metas.description: Out 25 Oct 2024 — After crash-landing on an alien planet, an asteroid miner must contend with the challenges of his new surroundings, while making his way across the harsh terrain to the only other survivor – a woman who is trapped in her escape pod.

metas.name: Alien Country
metas.description: Out 25 Oct 2024 — Reeling from the news of an unexpected pregnancy, Jimmy and Everly unknowingly release an alien invasion in their small town and learn to work together in order to save each other, their town and evidently, the entire galaxy.

metas.name: Spirit in the Blood
metas.description: Out 25 Oct 2024 — After a young girl is found dead in a secluded religious mountain community, a pack of teenage girls decide to fight against the evil spirits they believe killed her by embracing their own dark nature.

metas.name: Don't Move
metas.description: Out 25 Oct 2024 — A grieving woman in a secluded forest encounters a killer who injects her with a paralytic drug. As her body shuts down, her fight for survival begins.

metas.name: Canary Black
metas.description: Out 24 Oct 2024 — Top level CIA agent Avery Graves is blackmailed by terrorists into betraying her own country to save her kidnapped husband. Cut off from her team, she turns to her underworld contacts to survive and help locate the coveted intelligence that the kidnappers want.

metas.name: Loups-Garous AKA Family Pack
metas.description: Out 23 Oct 2024 — When an old card game comes to life, a family jumps back in time to a medieval village where they must unmask werewolves to secure their return home.

metas.name: Classified
metas.description: Out 22 Oct 2024 — Operating alone in the field for more than 20 years, a CIA hitman uses the "Help Wanted" section of the newspapers to get his orders from the Agency. His long-lost daughter, now a UK MI6 analyst, tracks him down to deliver shocking news: his CIA boss has been dead for years and the division long since shut down. Together, they set out to discover whose orders he's been executing.

metas.name: Carved
metas.description: Out 21 Oct 2024 — On Halloween 1993, the staff of a historic pioneer village attraction must work together to survive the attack of a monstrous killer pumpkin set on revenge.

metas.name: I Will Never Leave You Alone
metas.description: Out 19 Oct 2024 — After being released from prison, a brooding man with a dark past is forced to stay in a haunted house to clear it of spirits. If he leaves, he goes back to prison, but the witch-ghost may be more punishment than he can withstand.

trailerStreams.title: I Will Never Leave You Alone — trailer

metas.name: Woman of the Hour
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — An aspiring actress crosses paths with a prolific serial killer in '70s LA when they're cast on an episode of "The Dating Game."

metas.name: Rippy
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — Young police officer Maddy is determined to live up to her deceased father's legacy. Her courage is put to the test when locals are found brutally ripped to shreds by the zombie kangaroo. As the undead beast leaves a trail of carnage, Maddy, with the help of her eccentric Uncle Schmitty and resilient Aunt Donna, must embark on a high-stakes battle to save the town.

metas.name: MadS
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — A teenager stops off to see his dealer to test a new drug before heading off for a night of partying. On the way home, he picks up an injured woman, and the night takes a surreal turn.

metas.name: Bagman
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — For centuries and across cultures, parents have warned their children of the legendary Bagman, who snatches innocent children and stuffs them into his vile, rotting bag—never to be seen again. Patrick McKee narrowly escaped such an encounter as a boy, which left him with lasting scars throughout his adulthood. Now, Patrick’s childhood tormentor has returned, threatening the safety of his wife Karina and son Jake.

metas.name: Lee
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — The true story of photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller, a fashion model who became an acclaimed war correspondent for Vogue magazine during World War II.

metas.name: The Stoic
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — A group of mercenary leaders convene in a country retreat after pulling off a drug raid. Things take a turn for the worse after they raise the attentions of 'The Stoic', a man from an ancient clan of smugglers.

metas.name: Die Alone
metas.description: Out 18 Oct 2024 — Lost in a world reclaimed by nature and overrun by mysterious creatures, Ethan, a young man with amnesia navigates the dangerous landscape in search of his lost love Emma.  His journey takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Mae, a hardened and eccentric survivor.  Together, Ethan and Mae face threats both human and otherwise before a fateful encounter with Kai unravels a secret that lies just beyond Ethan's fractured memory.

metas.name: Falling Stars
metas.description: Out 17 Oct 2024 — On the night of first harvest, three brothers in the American West set out to see a dead witch buried by their friend. When they accidentally desecrate the body, they learn the only way to stop a curse on their family is to burn it before sunrise.

metas.name: Outside
metas.description: Out 17 Oct 2024 — A family retreats to an isolated farm during a zombie outbreak, but years of painful secrets take a toll as they navigate their desolate world.

metas.name: The Shadow Strays
metas.description: Out 17 Oct 2024 — Skilled in the art of killing, a young assassin defies her mentor to save a boy from a ruthless crime syndicate — and she'll destroy anyone in her path.

metas.name: Brothers
metas.description: Out 17 Oct 2024 — A reformed criminal's attempt at going straight is derailed when he reunites with his sanity-testing twin brother on a road trip for the score of a lifetime. Dodging bullets, the law, and an overbearing mother along the way, they must heal their severed family bond before they end up killing each other.

metas.name: 9 Windows
metas.description: Out 17 Oct 2024 — After a tragic accident kills her parents, Liza, unable to walk, spends her days terrorizing vloggers. When she witnesses a murder online, the police dismisses it as a hoax, and it's up to Liza to find the killer.

metas.name: Napad AKA Justice
metas.description: Out 16 Oct 2024 — A young detective seeks the help of a discharged police officer, giving him the chance to reclaim his old life in exchange for solving a bank raid case.

metas.name: Nobody's Home
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — When Theodora's boyfriend Luca is set to be released from the institution where they are both admitted, she escapes with him and tries to re-traumatize him so he remains under her control. They end up at his childhood home where a knock on the door sends them spiraling into a confusing night of games and manipulation rooted in lies, insecurity, and fear.

metas.name: En attendant la nuit AKA For Night Will Come
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — The day they move into a new neighborhood, the Feral family plans to look as normal and friendly as possible. But their son, Philemon, is no ordinary teenager. When he gets closer to his new neighbor, Camila, his thirst for blood grows and his difference becomes impossible to hide…

trailerStreams.title: En attendant la nuit AKA For Night Will Come — trailer

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

metas.name: Reagan
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — Told through the voice of former KGB agent Viktor Petrovich, whose life becomes inextricably linked with Ronald Reagan's when Reagan first caught the Soviets’ attention as an actor in Hollywood, Reagan overcomes the odds to become the 40th president of the United States.

metas.name: Good One
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — On a weekend backpacking trip in the Catskills, 17-year-old Sam contends with the competing egos of her father and his oldest friend.

metas.name: Depravity
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — A group of residents begins to suspect that their strange neighbor might be hiding something dark.

metas.name: Stream
metas.description: Out 15 Oct 2024 — As the Keenans try to bring their family closer together, they unwittingly enter themselves into a game of life or death. With four deranged killers patrolling the halls of their hotel and competing for the most creative kills, the odds are definitely stacked against them.

metas.name: Alien: Romulus
metas.description: Out 14 Oct 2024 — While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

metas.name: Bookworm
metas.description: Out 14 Oct 2024 — Eleven-year-old Mildred’s life is turned upside down when her mother lands in hospital and estranged, American magician father, Strawn Wise, comes to look after her.  Hoping to entertain the bookish tween, Strawn takes Mildred camping in the notoriously rugged New Zealand wilderness, and the pair embark on the ultimate test of family bonding – a quest to find the mythological beast known as the Canterbury Panther.

metas.name: Remnant
metas.description: Out 13 Oct 2024 — Grace is a young woman whose life has been turned upside down by tragedy. When she returns home to the family farm to rebuild her shattered life, her world begins to unravel as a series of strange events haunt her, pushing Grace to the edge of madness. A mysterious figure lurks in the shadows and a ghostly woman appears in the darkness of night. Is Grace imagining these apparitions, or are they a warning of a nightmare still to come?

metas.name: The Substance
metas.description: Out 12 Oct 2024 — A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.

metas.name: Dominique
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — Dominique, a well-trained assassin, flees from her troubled past in an attempt to begin a new life in South America. However, she soon finds herself in a town plagued with violence and corruption. Facing brutal attacks from the police and mafia, Dominique must decide whether to protect herself or an innocent family that has taken her in.

metas.name: Bad Genius
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — A highly-gifted student sees an opportunity to escape her roots by helping wealthy classmates cheat on key exams, but at great risk to her future.

metas.name: Lonely Planet
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — At an idyllic writers retreat in Morocco, a newly single novelist finds an unexpected connection with a younger man who's reevaluating his life choices.

metas.name: El lugar de la otra AKA In Her Place
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — After Chilean writer María Carolina Geel murders her lover, the case captivates shy legal secretary Mercedes, sparking a connection between the two women.

trailerStreams.title: El lugar de la otra AKA In Her Place — trailer

metas.name: Uprising
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — In the Joseon Dynasty, two friends who grew up together — one the master and one the servant — reunite post-war as enemies on opposing sides.

metas.name: Daddy's Head
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — A boy and his stepmother fear for their safety after an eerie creature resembling the boy's recently deceased father visits them.

metas.name: Mr. Crocket
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — A single mother thinks she's found the key to calming her child down – a VHS copy of a strange children's program named Mr. Crocket's World. However, a darker, bloodier secret waits to invade their home from inside the tape.

metas.name: The Silent Hour
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — While working a case as an interpreter, a hearing-impaired police detective must confront a group of criminals trying to eliminate a deaf murder witness in her apartment building.

metas.name: Never Let Go
metas.description: Out 11 Oct 2024 — As an evil takes over the world beyond their front doorstep, the only protection for a mother and her twin sons is their house and their family’s protective bond.

metas.name: Girl Haunts Boy
metas.description: Out 10 Oct 2024 — Cole, a teen grieving the loss of his dad, forms an unlikely bond with Bea, a ghost. As they navigate life and death, they must break an ancient curse.

metas.name: Caddo Lake
metas.description: Out 10 Oct 2024 — When an 8-year-old girl mysteriously vanishes on Caddo Lake, a series of past deaths and disappearances begin to link together, forever altering a broken family’s history.

metas.name: Good Girl Jane
metas.description: Out 9 Oct 2024 — Struggling to fit in in her new school and reeling from the fallout of her parent’s recent divorce, lonely LA high schooler Jane falls in with a rambunctious crowd, and becomes smitten with their charming drug supplier, Jamie.

metas.name: Haunt Season
metas.description: Out 9 Oct 2024 — A masked maniac targets cast members at a suburban Halloween haunt attraction, turning their staged injuries into gruesome real-life horrors. As the terror escalates, the lines between performance and reality blur.

metas.name: A New York Story
metas.description: Out 8 Oct 2024 — Annabel, a young woman who risks being ostracized from an insular New York clique led by her socialite best friend when she falls for charming photographer Theo. Grappling with the sudden loss of her father, Annabel finds herself torn between the comfortable opulence of her upper crust circle and the vibrant ambitions of the artists downtown. As Theo introduces her to unexplored sides of the city and of herself, how far will Annabel push out of her gilded cage?

metas.name: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
metas.description: Out 8 Oct 2024 — After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Betelgeuse, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Afterlife.

metas.name: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
metas.description: Out 8 Oct 2024 — Hellboy and a rookie BPRD agent get stranded in 1950s rural Appalachia. There, they discover a small community haunted by witches, led by a local devil with a troubling connection to Hellboy's past: the Crooked Man.

metas.name: Take Cover
metas.description: Out 7 Oct 2024 — A burned-out professional sniper finds himself trapped in an all-glass penthouse by a lethal competitor and must find a way to survive and escape with little to no cover between him and the killer.

metas.name: The Problem with People
metas.description: Out 7 Oct 2024 — Two estranged cousins who never knew each other try to make amends for many generations of family dispute.

metas.name: Azrael
metas.description: Out 6 Oct 2024 — In a world where no one speaks, a devout female hunts down a young woman who has escaped her imprisonment. Recaptured by its ruthless leaders, Azrael is due to be sacrificed to pacify an ancient evil deep within the surrounding wilderness.

metas.name: La Espera AKA The Wait
metas.description: Out 6 Oct 2024 — Eladio, hunting estate keeper, takes a bribe from a veteran hunter. Weeks later, his whole life falls apart. What looked like the opportunity of a lifetime, turns into a macabre descent to hell when he finds out that his misfortune might not be entirely by chance.

trailerStreams.title: La Espera AKA The Wait — trailer

metas.name: El Diario AKA The Diary
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — Olga discovers the unfinished diary of a notorious killer and becomes captivated by its dark secrets. As she delves deeper, she uncovers a mysterious connection between them, putting her life—and the lives of those around her—in grave danger.

trailerStreams.title: El Diario AKA The Diary — trailer

metas.name: Things Will Be Different
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — In order to escape the police after a robbery, two estranged siblings lay low in a metaphysical farmhouse that hides them away in a different time. There they reckon with a mysterious force that pushes their familial bonds to unnatural breaking points.

metas.name: Spin the Bottle
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — When a group of friends play spin the bottle in a house marked by a brutal massacre, they unknowingly unleash an evil spirit and start dying in terrifying ways. Now, the survivors must stick together to uncover the house's dark secrets and end the bloodshed.

metas.name: It's What's Inside
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — A pre-wedding reunion descends into a psychological nightmare for a group of college friends when a surprise guest arrives with a mysterious suitcase.

metas.name: The Platform 2
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — After a mysterious leader imposes his law in a brutal system of vertical cells, a new arrival battles against a dubious food distribution method.

metas.name: The Radleys
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — A seemingly ordinary family harbors a dark secret: they are vampires. They choose not to drink blood despite their natural cravings, but one day, their truth comes to light.

metas.name: Little Bites
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — Mindy, a young widow and mother who tries to protect her daughter Alice from a flesh eating monster named Agyar. Mindy has been secretly sacrificing her own life by allowing the creature to feast on her body as she keeps Alice hidden away at her grandmother’s house.

metas.name: The Killer's Game
metas.description: Out 4 Oct 2024 — When top hitman Joe Flood is diagnosed with a terminal illness, he decides to take matters into his own hands – by taking a hit out on himself. But when the very hitmen he hired also target his ex-girlfriend, he must fend off an army of assassin colleagues and win back the love of his life before it's too late.

metas.name: House of Spoils
metas.description: Out 3 Oct 2024 — An ambitious chef opens a restaurant on a remote estate where she battles kitchen chaos, crushing self doubts… and a haunting presence who threatens to sabotage her at every turn.

metas.name: Strul AKA Trouble
metas.description: Out 3 Oct 2024 — Wrongfully convicted of murder, a clumsy electronics salesman faces police corruption and criminal conspiracies in an attempt to prove his innocence.

metas.name: Salem's Lot
metas.description: Out 3 Oct 2024 — Author Ben Mears returns to his childhood home of Jerusalem's Lot only to discover his hometown is being preyed upon by a bloodthirsty vampire.

metas.name: Hold Your Breath
metas.description: Out 3 Oct 2024 — In 1930s Oklahoma amid the region's horrific dust storms, a woman is convinced that a sinister presence is threatening her family.

metas.name: I'll Play Mother
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — After the death of their birth mother, two young children are placed in the care of prospective adopter parents, however, it's not long before the new family begin to question if something more sinister is at play.

metas.name: Survive
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — A couple celebrates their son’s birthday in the middle of the ocean on their boat. A violent storm hits and it brings up hungry creatures from the depths and they fight for their survival.

metas.name: The 4:30 Movie
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — In the summer of 1986, three sixteen year old friends spend their Saturdays sneaking into movies at the local multiplex. But when one of the guys also invites the girl of his dreams to see the latest comedy, each of the teens learn more about life and love.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — When an American family is invited to spend the weekend at the idyllic country estate of a charming British family they befriended on vacation, what begins as a dream holiday soon warps into a snarled psychological nightmare.

metas.name: Strange Darling
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — Nothing is what it seems when a twisted one-night stand spirals into a serial killer’s vicious murder spree.

metas.name: My Penguin Friend
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — A lost penguin rescued from an oil spill transforms the life of a heartbroken fisherman. They become unlikely friends, so bonded that even the vast ocean cannot divide them.

metas.name: The Curse of the Necklace
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — After separating due to his unpredictable alcohol infused temper, Frank try to win his wife Laura back by giving her a beautiful antique necklace he finds in an old 1938 evidence bag at the station. Unfortunately, the necklace is a conduit for the tormented soul of an evil boy from long ago, and Laura and her daughters find themselves in terrible danger from a little boy who no longer exists.

trailerStreams.title: The Curse of the Necklace — trailer

metas.name: Cassino in Ischia
metas.description: Out 1 Oct 2024 — A former film star travels to Italy to work with a struggling director in order to revitalize his career.

metas.name: Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Out 30 Sep 2024 — A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

metas.name: The Wasp
metas.description: Out 30 Sep 2024 — Heather bumps into Carla, having not spoken to her in years, and presents her with a very unexpected proposition that could change both of their lives forever.

metas.name: Bibi
metas.description: Out 29 Sep 2024 — A woman tormented by grief, battles inner demons using medication and drugs. Reality blurs with nightmares which strains her relationships. Seeking truth, she questions sanity, facing chilling revelations in a desperate quest for answers.

metas.name: Winter Island
metas.description: Out 29 Sep 2024 — When a young girl is found dead on a small, wooded island, her teenage brother's postmortem visions point to an evil presence within their own family.

metas.name: Unit 234
metas.description: Out 29 Sep 2024 — While working the night shift alone, Laurie Saltair discovers a comatose man, Clayton, in Unit 234 of her family’s storage facility. What transpires is a thrill ride of a cat-and-mouse game for Laurie and Clayton to survive the night.

metas.name: City of Dreams
metas.description: Out 28 Sep 2024 — A Mexican teenager whose dreams of becoming a soccer star are disrupted when his mother dies. He's smuggled across the border with the promise of a better life but is instead sold to a sweatshop in downtown LA.

metas.name: No Voltees
metas.description: Out 28 Sep 2024 — When two siblings return to their childhood home, they are confronted by a violent, ominous presence that dwells deep within their worst traumas.

metas.name: Haunted Heart
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — On a beautiful remote island in Greece, young and spirited Alex joins the team of a boutique seaside restaurant as their new waitress. Despite her femme-fatale charm quickly winning the heart of the charismatic Enrico, she instead falls for the enigmatic restaurant manager Max, a reclusive American who settled on the island decades ago. As the seasons pass, sexual tensions rise, and tourists come and go, Enrico begins to unearth disturbing clues about Max's dark and mysterious past.

metas.name: Amber Alert
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — A ride-share turns into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse after it follows a car fitting the description of an AMBER Alert.

metas.name: Rez Ball
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — After losing their star player, a high school basketball team rooted in Native American culture must unite to keep their state championship dreams alive.

metas.name: Balestra
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — Joanna is a competitive fencer at the end of her career who is desperate to be the world’s best. In order to gain an edge, she pursues an experimental technology, allowing her to train via lucid dreaming, where she begins a tumultuous affair with her instructor that threatens her real world marriage and her pathway to Olympic gold.

metas.name: She Taught Love
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — Ever since getting off a prestigious cable television series, Frank Cooper has been coasting through life distracting himself with women, booze and blow, while auditioning to play stereotypical gang members and drug dealers. But the minute he meets Mali Waters, a sports agent living for the present, his whole world changes.

metas.name: Wolfs
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — Hired to cover up a high-profile crime, a fixer soon finds his night spiralling out of control when he's forced to work with an unexpected counterpart.

metas.name: Apartment 7A
metas.description: Out 27 Sep 2024 — A struggling young dancer finds herself drawn in by dark forces when a peculiar, well-connected older couple promise her a shot at fame.

metas.name: Previously Saved Version
metas.description: Out 26 Sep 2024 — In the year 2200, Naoki and Mayumi live in a luxurious floating residence in space. Outwardly the perfect couple, Naoki secretly seeks revenge on his wife and transforms her into an android to pursue and recreate his own ideal.

metas.name: Killer Heat
metas.description: Out 26 Sep 2024 — An expat PI is hired to investigate a suspicious death in Crete, Greece, where jealousies run deep amongst the victim's powerful family.

metas.name: Beezel
metas.description: Out 25 Sep 2024 — Over six tumultuous decades, three unwitting guests of a cursed New England home stumble upon a sinister secret dwelling beneath its floors - an eternal witch with an insatiable thirst for the flesh of the living.

metas.name: Succubus
metas.description: Out 24 Sep 2024 — A new father going through a marital separation joins a dating app and matches with a beautiful but mysterious young woman... whose powers of seduction and manipulation entangle him in a mystery more horrifying than he could have ever imagined.

metas.name: The Front Room
metas.description: Out 24 Sep 2024 — Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda after her mother-in-law moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere.

metas.name: It Ends with Us
metas.description: Out 23 Sep 2024 — When a woman's first love suddenly reenters her life, her relationship with a charming, but abusive neurosurgeon is upended, and she realizes she must learn to rely on her own strength to make an impossible choice for her future.

metas.name: Peak Season
metas.description: Out 22 Sep 2024 — An emotionally adrift young woman forges an unexpected bond with a wilderness guide when she and her fiance take a summer holiday in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

metas.name: The Thicket
metas.description: Out 21 Sep 2024 — An innocent young man, Jack, goes on an epic quest to rescue his sister Lula after she has been kidnapped by the violent killer Cut Throat Bill and her gang. To save her, Jack enlists the help of a crafty bounty hunter named Reginald Jones, a grave-digging alcoholic son of an ex-slave, and a street-smart prostitute. The gang tracks Cut Throat Bill into the deadly no-man’s land known as The Big Thicket — a place where blood and chaos reign.

metas.name: Omni Loop
metas.description: Out 20 Sep 2024 — Diagnosed with a black hole growing inside her chest and stuck in a loop reliving the last five days of her life, a 55-year-old wife and mother from Miami, Florida decides to solve time travel in order to go back and be the person she always intended to be.
